a.text: A hunter is walking on seacoast way♪
With homeland left a mile behind, his path lies ahead♪
From his forebears and children, he was torn♪
Into the seas his lover was swept away, floating in the deep, dead♪
A hunter is walking on seacoast way♪
With homeland left a mile behind, they must lament and pray♪
There is no end to his path♪
The road ahead is shrouded in gray♪
A hunter returns by seacoast way♪
His journey ended, his home close at hand♪
Sound of waves past above the spray♪
Why do his feet disobey his command♪
Why ever does his heart still sway♪

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Been a while, Doctor.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You were supposed to meet that chatty Liberi, but you don't seem surprised to see me.

options: You and Elysium are both Rhodes operators.
This is a lot closer to your homeland, after all.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Hmm. True.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: You're an hour later than Kal'tsit estimated.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I guess the Inquisition's review process is strict, even with an official notice from a Saint.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: After only three months, nearly all the town's residents have moved inland, aside from a few workers. Replaced by lots of people from the Penal Battalion.

options: They must be preparing for something.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Ægir contacted Iberia a week ago. This forgotten town has become a lot less quiet since.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Being surrounded by sea scum already sets the young soldiers on edge. Hearing Ægir's voice only made it worse.

options: It demands a response, maybe caution.
When the undersea nation finally speaks, you have to listen.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Turn left at the sculpture, and the sea is a quick ten minute walk.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We'll head straight to the Eye of Iberia.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Say, Doctor, do you hear the sound of the waves?
Skadi turns her head slightly into the sea breeze. Her hair dances in the wind, the same color as the shadows in her eyes.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Their layering has gotten complex. I hear... the sound of stars drifting across the sky. The never-ending song of nature. And a language, forever incomprehensible...

a.text: The hardship we suffer is ever present.
The life we thirst for is ever present.

options: Did reconnecting with home put you on edge?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's like I get more nervous the closer I am... Never mind. It's hard to explain.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Maybe I'm sleep-deprived. Ever since our last voyage, I feel like I've inherited Shark's nightmares.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Speaking of the sea, why did Dr. Kal'tsit call you over so urgently?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I don't remember you having anything to do with the ocean.

options: I wouldn't recall even if I did.
But it doesn't feel unfamiliar, at least.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Not much of an answer.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Right, I forgot about your condition. No wonder you gave such an answer.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Oh well. I'm sure she had her reasons.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Let's go. It'll be dark soon.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: I would take a step back if I were you. I need to shake myself dry.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hey there, Dr. Kal'tsit. Not many people can track us Abyssal Hunters. Did Swordfish tell you we'd be coming ashore here in advance?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Elysium deployed a data collector in these waters. It's had a direct connection to the Eye of Iberia's central control system ever since its calibration.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And it can already track underwater targets? That Liberi's not half-bad.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Am I to understand then that Rhodes Island and the Inquisition have deepened their ties?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: One week ago, the undersea city contacted Iberia via a special comms frequency, informing them that Ægir would be establishing a 'Waterway' between the Ægir home territories and dry land.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: In the face of such a grand project, Iberia could only gather intelligence through the great lighthouse's positioning system.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Evidently, your position as Chief Designer of Warfare did not afford you any knowledge of this.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Tell Kal'tsit what we discovered, Shark.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The captain and I have swum out to where the Stultifera sank three times now. Our last dive was only ten days ago.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The first time, we could still see the exploded wreckage on the sea floor. Under what little light filtered through from the surface, the gilded interior was more like a smudge of paint.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But this time around, the entire thing had completely disappeared, replaced by a cluster of coral, thrumming with life.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I may be accustomed to dreaming, but that felt unreal even to me.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: That monument to a lost civilization and its history stood for but a brief time.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The Stultifera Navis has been completely claimed by the sea.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Or to be precise, it's become part of a Seaborn nest.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Their environmental assimilation is accelerating.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: At a frightening pace.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: But there was something even more noteworthy. We found traces of battle. Recent ones.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: A completely barren patch of sea, lacking even marine snow. A warped and shattered stretch of sea floor, clearly pockmarked by micro-singularities.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Only the fleets of Ægir's Legions could be behind that.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: As a landwalker, Kal'tsit, the knowledge of and interest you hold towards Ægir are nothing less than extraordinary.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Though separated by the boundless seas, Ægir has always been a part of Terra.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Regardless, Gladiia and I have decided to head to that city.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A risky decision, no doubt.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Perhaps a tad.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Considerably.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: As such, we Hunters have been observing it for a while.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Before our final operation, I attended a military conference between the Academy of Science and the Academy of Technology, as the Abyssal Hunters' Chief Designer of Warfare.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Among the battle plans they drew up together, I do not recall anyone calling for a military stronghold to approach dry land with, nor any project involving 'Waterways.'

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Ægir has, without a doubt, undergone great changes.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Our contact with the home territories was completely severed after we slew Ishar'mla. It is difficult to determine the truth of the matter from the information we possess.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yet still hardly reason enough for you to return to Ægir. I don't believe I'm the first to try to dissuade you, either. Didn't your colleague already do so?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Do you mean... Ulpianus?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: He would understand that the land holds no answers for us. We must return to the sea.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If his strategy is to maintain a distance from Ægir, then all the more reason for us to return in an official capacity.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: ...Ever since I awoke from my dream, the waves would tell me, time and again, that the lost should return home.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: The Abyssal Hunters must return.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Very well, I understand.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Then I'll go with you, Gladiia.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: That would indeed be a rare opportunity for you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will be representing more than myself on this visit. More than Rhodes Island, even.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Iberia as well? Even with all that you already bear, they would give you another burden?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: It was also my decision.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island's cooperation with the Iberian Inquisition has only just begun. Much like our own.
Kal'tsit stares at Gladiia. The Hunter's face remains devoid of expression, even the blowing sea wind failed to crease it.
After a short moment of silence, Gladiia nods her head.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: How many days has it been since we were contacted by Ægir, Irene?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Eight, Su Santidad.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: And outside of the necessary deployments, meetings, and to rest, you've spent those eight days here, watching the sea.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: They haven't given us a concrete time frame for their next contact. I understand you don't wish to miss their next move, but...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Look at the sea before you, Irene.
The colors of the deep sea bubble up, nearly indistinguishable from one another. Against the vastness of the ocean surface, the sky seems gloomy.
The water crash against the reef, whipping up waves several meters tall, their roars dashing against this small corner of the land.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: By Iberian standards, an ocean without a hint of Sea Terror flesh is a gentle one, no matter how noisy it may be.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: An old friend of mine was once the most talented bard of the port.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: But after that grand port sank into Silence, he fled north, past the starving masses to the Iberian interior, to the small town that would one day become the capital.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I saw him kneeling by the broken town gates, weeping uncontrollably. From his weeping, the town obtained its new name: Perdonidora. 'Forgiveness has left us.'

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: However, what people needed at the time was not mourning, but consolation. Many prefer to use the shortened form, Perdoni. 'Forgiveness.'

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: And now, the last Eye of Iberia, the final legacy of the Golden Age, shines bright once more. What do you think that signals, Irene?

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Hope and determination.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: 'Hope and determination.' Of course.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Ah, youth. The determination in your eyes is brighter than Dario's when he was your age. Good, good.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: But those words, as inspiring as they are, are often not the fully correct answer.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: After half a century of being pushed back, our front is finally advancing. Soon, this will become the new center of the Inquisition.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: But at the same time, we must necessarily bare everything to the ocean. To Seaborn and Ægir alike.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Iberia is stretched thin. This country can no longer hide its exhaustion and sickness. It is a simple fact, plain for all to see.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: And there is another fact to consider. We can retreat no further.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Maestro—Ah, it's been a while, Doña Irene.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Indeed it has.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Those clothes suit you.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Th-Thank you.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Ah, right, there's been an emergency. The lighthouse just picked up signals of unknown origin.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: They seem to be coming from not the sea, but the sky.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Jordi. I think we can already seen them...
Carmen and Irene are fixated on the distant sky. The young clerk follows suit.
He freezes on the spot.
They see a school of fins soaring through the sky.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What are they?

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Bionic drones. The Islanders brought similar creations to land, all those years ago.
The matrix of drones crosses the sea in the blink of an eye, matching the height of the towering lighthouse. One separates itself from the formation and slowly hovers before the three.
Its wings open and close like fins, like a speck of light dancing in the void, and soon after an amiable and charismatic female voice resounds from it.
(Iberian) People of Iberia. Do not be alarmed.
Ægir greets you.
I am Clementia, a technology consul of our Institute of Societal and Administrative Supervision.
Carmen holds his lantern aloft, looking serenely at the drone before him.
Two completely different forms of light face each other, as though in a dialogue between two different civilizations—or a confrontation.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Saint Carmen I Iberia, of the Iberian Inquisition.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I believe this is the first official communication between our nations.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: You speak our tongue as well as any Iberian.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: I installed an Iberian language module before leaving the home territories. I hope you'll forgive me if I ever use the wrong expression.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: Moreover, forgive me for having to contact you in this form, Sir... Iberia.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: We have no objections to your appearance, Madame Consul. I only regret that it has taken us so long to begin this conversation.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Despite your so-called 'Waterway' project being more than half-complete and close at hand, we Iberians find ourselves in complete ignorance of it.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: To make amends, we'd like to invite your envoys to visit our city. Ægir respects the efforts Iberia has made when you were caught up in the Seaborn crisis.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: 'Caught up in.' Do you mean to say that everything Iberia has faced was merely the aftermath of your crisis?

spans.text: 'Caught up in.' Do you mean to say that everything Iberia has faced was merely the aftermath of

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: I do.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: Let's not be tied down by formalities, Sir.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: We recognize the power of language. Your name itself, Carmen I Iberia, is a symbol. A symbol of courage and valor.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: This is why we came to you. We hope that by reaching an accord with Iberia and the other terrestrial nations, we will be able to create a Waterway that links directly to land.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: We will clear the stretch of sea between Ægir's home territories and the land, so as to facilitate our forces coming ashore.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: ...I hope I need not remind you what sending an army to another nation's border implies on land.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: Given the enormity of the oncoming threat, we will exhaust every means at our disposal to resist it.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: I am more than willing to come explain to you in person if necessary, but it would be easier for you to understand the situation if you were to join us in the depths.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: The fleets of our Legions VIII and X are patrolling and suppressing the Seaborn in these waters. They will soon escort you to our city of Milliarium.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: This drone formation will continue to notify you of any nearby combat or environmental changes until you have safely arrived at the city.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: There may be an unprecedented disaster brewing beneath the waves.

steps.name: Clementia
steps.text: Sir Inquisitor, I worry that though the earth is vast, it is but an isolated island.
The lights of the drone matrix cut out, putting a stop to their sudden communication.
The sea breeze continues to blow as the old man slowly lowers his lantern.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: 'A Waterway that links directly to land.' She's eloquent, but...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Arrogant. No doubt.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: A haughty adult wielding a weapon, loathe to use finesse when dealing with an unarmed child.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Irene, inform our cooperation partners of this most recent communication.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Kal'tsit has already agreed to serve as Iberia's envoy. The Abyssal Hunters should also have made their decision by now, considering they've always had reservations about the Waterway program.

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: Right away!

steps.name: Irene
steps.text: I'll also keep the other Inquisitors in Gran Faro abreast of the situation.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I've made a recording of your entire conversation with Ægir, Maestro. Please, take a look.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: A-As for whether you approve of me going...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I recall you submitted your application a week ago.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Yes. Since the Ægir fleet is on their way now, I was wondering if...

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Never hesitate when you've already made up your mind. It only makes you less persuasive.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: When I was younger, Uncle Thiago was always worrying about me. He'd tell me: 'Jordi, you should leave Gran Faro. Leave Iberia.'

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: But he never told me where to go.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Ægir was always my homeland under the sea, but I had no way of approaching it. I'd never heard the voice of Ægir, or seen its cities.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: But now, it's so, so close.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: The Inquisition has approved your application, Jordi Fontanarossa. You will serve as an envoy of Iberia, and accompany Irene and Kal'tsit to the Ægir city.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Thank you, Maestro.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Don't thank me. This isn't a reward. Your work since joining the Inquisition has not been particularly good.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: I chose Irene because she has already readied herself, even going as far as to renounce her long-standing faith.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: And I chose you because you are still bewildered and frustrated. Your weakness will consume you.

steps.name: Saint Carmen
steps.text: Joining the Inquisition was a test. Returning to your homeland is another.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... I understand.

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: (Agitated whinny)

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This is the deepest part of the trench.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: They hollowed out its sides to make their nest. That's why we never noticed it before, despite circling this place several times.

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: (Wary whinny)

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Yes. I smell it too.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: This scent... After destroying the ocean's native ecosystem, the Seaborn have created a new one that serves only them.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: A comprehensive Seaborn ecosystem, where once it only existed in an oceanic abyss.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Return, Rocinante. I will carry on alone.

steps.name: Rocinante
steps.text: (Swaying its neck in annoyance)

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The entire continental shelf has changed. I must know who churned these waves.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Tell the Knight to continue the hunt.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: We will not be parted for long.
Ulpianus swims into the nest.
He chooses not to use stealth. Luminescent vegetative Seaborn light up every corner of the nest. There is nowhere to hide in the first place.
Atop sets of spiraling blades, minute and curiously-shaped organisms sleep, or perhaps drift along.

The rocks of the seafloor cannot be seen. The fine tendrils of the nethersea brand slowly sway in the current, catching fragments of organic matter. They weave together into thick mats, drowning out any sound Ulpianius makes.
He can sense the changes in his own body. His consciousness extends and his body relaxes, as though every cell in his body is trying to respond to something.
He is clearly an invader, but the entire lair blooms in response to him.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Ul... Ul-pian... Guh... Ul-pianus. Kin.
Ulpianus is nearly able to see through the approaching Seaborn's translucent body. He waits for it to spit out its clumsy words about preying or being preyed on by him, but nothing comes.
The Seaborn thinks about his thoughts.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Finally. You have traveled far.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Here. Sufficient nutrients. Shed your cumbersome flesh.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Return. Grow. Migrate.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: For you, I was born, Ul-pianus. Only for you.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: I untangle your. Doubt. I guide you. Return to the embrace of we many.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Why did you migrate? Where will you go?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You still waver, Ul-pianus.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: You must know we many, kin. You must know.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: The genesezoic will soon awaken. The genesezoic must return. A new Cycle. Develop the ocean. Leave the ocean.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The genesezoic will awaken? Leave the ocean?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: We many. See. A new path ahead. We hurry—

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...What connection is there between you and the affairs of the city?
